header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Afzal Karim Virk advocate for the applicant
Mr. Dhani Bux, Assistant P.G a/w SHO P.S Nangarparkar
Mr. Jeeloji Rajput advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of
respondent No.6, which is taken on record.
This transfer application has been filed solely on the ground that
the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Tharparkar at Mithi,
is lying vacant where Illegal Dispossession Complaint No. 96 of 2025
(“the case”) is pending. Learned counsel for respondent has also
body: conceded this fact and raised no objection to the transfer of the case. Both learned counsels submit that the entire evidence as well as the statements of the accused in the case have already been recorded before the trial Court and now the matter is presently fixed for final arguments.

Under these circumstances, this transfer application is allowed. The case is transferred to the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Tharparkar at Mithi with direction to decide the same within 30 days after the receipt of R&Ps of the case.
